scripts.dev: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --test-scheduled
scripts.deploy: vite build && for f in dist/admin/_app/*; do npx wrangler r2 object put indiestack/assets/$(basename $f) --file=$f --remote >/dev/null 2>&1; done && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Optional. Leave blank — open /admin after deploy; a token is generated and shown once to copy. Or paste your own password here.
